title: Opus 4.8
raw_excerpt: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8 with benchmark improvements, adjustable effort controls, dynamic workflows in Claude Code, and a faster mode that became significantly cheaper.
summary: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 4.8，在多项基准测试上取得提升，引入可调节的“努力控制”机制、Claude Code 中的动态工作流，以及更快的模式（成本显著降低）。该版本进一步巩固了 Anthropic 在高端 AI 模型领域的竞争力，尤其对开发者工作流有重要影响。

title: Anthropic Raised $65B in Series H Funding
raw_excerpt: Anthropic announced a $65 billion Series H round at a $965 billion post-money valuation, citing strong enterprise adoption, $47 billion in run-rate revenue, and plans to expand compute capacity, research, and product development.
summary: Anthropic 宣布完成 650 亿美元 H 轮融资，投后估值达 9650 亿美元，年化收入 470 亿美元。本轮融资将用于扩展算力、研发和产品开发，标志着 AI 领域最大规模的单轮融资之一，凸显了企业级 AI 的强劲需求。

title: 4nm！比亚迪自研AI芯片来了：制程对齐英伟达，算力拉爆特斯拉
summary: 比亚迪自研 AI 芯片曝光，采用 4nm 制程，制程对齐英伟达，算力超越特斯拉。该芯片将用于智能驾驶系统，标志着中国车企在 AI 芯片领域的重要突破，有望降低对外部供应商的依赖并提升智驾性能。

title: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks, Environments, and Robot Embodiments
summary: 阿里通义千问团队发布 Qwen-VLA，一个统一视觉-语言-动作建模框架，可跨任务、环境和机器人本体工作。该模型将视觉、语言和动作统一建模，为机器人通用智能提供了新范式，在具身智能领域具有里程碑意义。

title: This AI startup will clean your home for free to train future robots
raw_excerpt: AI training startup Shift wants to clean your home for free. The catch - because, despite what its website says, there's always a catch - is that it will record cleaners as they scrub, vacuum, dust, tidy, and wash, and use that footage to train robots. Shift announced the unusual offer on social media on Thursday, explaining that the value of the training data generated from the cleanings is more than enough to fund the service. As its website puts it: "You get a spotless apartment. We get training data. Everyone wins." A promotional video shows a cleaner in a crisp white uniform and awkward-looking hat (more on that later) washing windows … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: AI 训练数据初创公司 Shift 推出免费家庭清洁服务，以换取清洁过程的录像，用于训练机器人。该模式揭示了机器人训练数据获取的新途径，也引发了关于隐私和数据价值的讨论。

title: MiniMax teases upcoming M3 model with new sparse attention mechanism and 15.6X long-context response speed boost
raw_excerpt: MiniMax has released a new in-depth technical report on the making of its popular M2 series of language models. The report sheds light on numerous engineering innovations and clever approaches. It teases a new sparse attention approach used in MiniMax's upcoming series of models that yields up to 15.6 times faster decode speed at long contexts. MiniMax's upcoming M3 models will make ultra-long-context AI agent deployment economically viable.
summary: MiniMax 发布 M3 模型技术报告，引入新型稀疏注意力机制，长上下文响应速度提升 15.6 倍。该技术使超长上下文 AI 代理部署在经济上可行，对需要处理大量上下文的场景（如代码生成、文档分析）意义重大。

title: Liquid AI reveals 8B-A1B MoE trained on 38T
summary: Liquid AI 发布 LFM 2.5 8B-A1B 模型，采用混合专家架构，在 38T token 上训练。该模型在保持高性能的同时大幅降低推理成本，为边缘部署和低成本 AI 应用提供了新选择。

title: Show HN: Tiny-vLLM – high performance LLM inference engine in C++ and CUDA
summary: 开发者发布 tiny-vLLM，一个用 C++ 和 CUDA 实现的高性能 LLM 推理引擎，代码开源。该项目展示了在资源受限环境下高效运行大模型的可能性，对边缘计算和嵌入式 AI 有重要参考价值。
